headline: Yen Carry Trade Faces Critical Test Ahead of Bank of Japan Decision
summary: The yen carry trade faces a critical test as the Bank of Japan meets with interest rates at 1.25% and global markets on edge.
why: Changes in Japanese monetary policy directly impact global liquidity flows, currency valuations, and the profitability of yen-funded carry trades.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Anticipation around Bank of Japan rate decisions heightens volatility in currency pairs tied to carry trade strategies.

why_moved: Speculation surrounding the Bank of Japan's rate stance at 1.25% creates heightened cross-border capital repositioning and currency volatility.
